subject: error in inla inlaprogram has crashed for exponential survival model

messages.author: 4031b4611d7c812a
messages.subject: error in inla inlaprogram has crashed for exponential survival model
parts:
Hello everybody,

I had been an INLA user for the past several years but due to a change in research interest, I have stopped using INLA for the past three years. However, one of my present research aims require the use of INLA for survival analysis.

To get a hang of it, I tried to run an exponential survival model using veteran.csv dataset based on a simple  code for exponential survival model obtained from Bayesian inference with INLA by Virgilio Gomez-Rubio. The code and dataset are as attached. I have scaled the survival time based on the advice that I found from this group. 

However, every time I run the inla code for the simple exponential model I always get the following error "Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully. If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>."

Upon running verbose = TRUE, the error codes I obtained the errors codes. They are given as attached.
 
I am using R Version 4.1.2 (Bird Hippie) implemented on R Studio Ghost Orchid release.

Any help / advice is greatly appreciated. All the best and cheers.

Razali

messages.author: 4031b4611d7c812a
messages.subject: Re: error in inla inlaprogram has crashed for exponential survival model
parts:
As additional information, I am running the code on Windows 10. I have just tried another simple example that is available on INLA website. However the same error crept in (very frustrating):

n = 100; a = 1; b = 1; tau = 100
z = rnorm(n)
eta = a + b*z

scale = exp(rnorm(n))
prec = scale*tau
y = rnorm(n, mean = eta, sd = 1/sqrt(prec))


data = list(y=y, z=z)
formula = y ~ 1+z
result = inla(formula, family = "gaussian", data = data)

summary(result)

Thanks.
